name: Coral Coast
description: The Coral Coast stretches along Viti Levu's southern shore — a ribbon of palm-fringed beaches, luxury resorts and traditional villages where fire-walking ceremonies and kava rituals still shape daily life.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit the Coral Coast?
faqs.answer: May through October offers dry, sunny weather ideal for beaches and water activities. November to April is warmer with lush landscapes and fewer crowds at luxury resorts.

faqs.question: How do I get to the Coral Coast?
faqs.answer: International flights arrive at Nadi International Airport. Private transfers, seaplanes and resort boats connect you to your final destination within hours.
